Who we are

Where ideas connect.

Team Nexus is a group of seven students from NMAMIT brought together through the Enhancing Self Competence (ESC) course. A nexus is where ideas, people and perspectives meet, and that is exactly what we set out to be. Through individual presentations, creative tasks and collaborative classroom activities, we explored topics ranging from everyday experiences to questions about technology and human behaviour. Every task gave us an opportunity to express our ideas, learn from different viewpoints and practise skills that are useful beyond the classroom. This website brings together those moments and the effort behind them.

Activities & teamwork

GROUP PRESENTATION

Different Types of Students Before an Exam

Our group presentation explored the different personalities students recognise in themselves and their classmates as exams approach. Using humour and relatable situations, we brought common study habits, last-minute preparation styles and exam-time reactions to life for the audience. Each team member contributed to turning the idea into a coordinated presentation, giving us a chance to practise planning, communication, timing and stage presence. The activity was designed to entertain while reminding us that everyone approaches exams differently—and that preparation, teamwork and understanding one another can make the experience easier to navigate.

Seven personalities. One exam. Which one are you?
